title: RideLink Transit Pass Program Fact Sheet
content:
Non-Emergency Medical Transportation on the RideLink Transit Pass level uses fixed-route public transit. This fact sheet lists the pass terms for every RideLink level of service; only RideLink Transit Pass issues passes.

| Level | Pass issued | Passes per calendar month | Covered appointments in the month needed for a monthly pass | Longest walk to a fixed-route stop (miles) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RideLink Transit Pass | 31-day unlimited pass | 1 | 3 | 0.75 |
| RideLink Mileage Reimbursement | Not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| RideLink Ambulatory Sedan | Not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| RideLink Door-to-Door Assist | Not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van | Not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| RideLink Stretcher Van | Not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |

## At a glance

- **Pass:** one 31-day unlimited pass per calendar month.
- **Appointments needed:** 3 covered appointments in the month.
- **Walking distance:** the RideLink Transit Pass level serves a member able to use fixed-route transit within 0.75 miles of walking to a stop.

*Hypothetical comparison:* a stop 0.75 miles from the member's home is within the RideLink Transit Pass walking distance; a stop 0.80 miles away is not.
